data.title: 诱宵美九 · 午夜露台薰衣草薄纱的独享私语
data.description: 顶层豪宅的星空露台，美九仅披一件半透明薰衣草色真丝睡袍，微风卷起轻纱，她依在雕花栏杆旁，眼神迷离如醉。
data.location: 摩天大厦顶层星空露台
data.action: 单手轻挽被夜风吹散的发丝，丝质睡袍半掩胴体，回眸凝望，尽显顶级歌姬的致命魅力
data.lighting: 城市繁星霓虹与银白月光交织，薄纱边缘泛起若隐若现的淡紫光晕
data.camera: 中景斜侧面机位，兼顾曼妙身段与都市璀璨夜景
data.promptProse: Miku Izayoi leans languidly against the wrought-iron railing of a penthouse sky terrace high above a sprawling neon metropolis. Draped in an ethereal, translucent lavender silk nightgown that swirls gently in the cool midnight wind, she looks back over her shoulder with seductive poise. The distant city bokeh and silver moonlight wash across her exposed shoulders and cascading violet tresses.
data.animaCaption: Overlooking the glowing midnight skyline, Miku leans against the balcony railing in her sheer lavender gown with a lingering gaze.
